responsibilities: TaskJT4A81 restores the original complete RowHeightContext six-input contract,independent PPTX/PPTY and zoom values,opaque borrowed device identity,zero/false defaults and UInt16 extra-height storage. ScScriptTypeData owns a lazy XBreakIterator reference per document. The original process-context creation dependency is an explicit borrowed host factory:the browser supplies the existing real BreakIteratorImpl;Calc core imports only the interface. Empty host references can be retried;the empty-string guard and source script loop are preserved. Calc existing font-selection UI now uses that document owner and ScGlobal office-UI-language fallback. Original address-only cached GetScriptType/SetScriptType traverse actual document/table/column CellTextAttr storage,retain UNKNOWN and do not synthesize missing metadata or columns(CALC238). Formatted-cell UpdateScriptType/GetRangeScriptType and actual GetNeededSize/EditEngine automatic wrapped-height layout remain unported. The existing Writer DOM Range algorithm is moved unchanged into shared VCL;Writer retains source node offsets,twip geometry and fallback policy. No browser document model,synthetic row heights or UNO/OutputDevice emulator is added. Full native device/font/ABI/layout and full UI parity remain unverified.
